root.title: Service Reliability Guide
root.scope: Organize the evidence needed for a source-backed reliability guide.

children.title: Purpose and audience
children.scope: State the required service outcome and the people who use the guide.
children.reviewText: Explain the reliability target for operators, developers, and reviewers.

children.title: Current behavior
children.scope: Describe the implemented retry path and the disputed failure behavior.

children.title: Runtime path
children.scope: Trace retry eligibility, attempt limits, and terminal outcomes.
children.reviewText: Connect each runtime step to the implementation and focused tests.

children.title: Failure-state conflict
children.scope: Keep the operator expectation separate from the observed timeout behavior.
children.reviewText: Show both accounts and leave the resolution open for an authoritative decision.

children.title: Operator workflow
children.scope: Describe detection, diagnosis, mitigation, and escalation in source order.

children.title: Detect and diagnose
children.scope: Identify the observable signals and the first diagnostic checks.
children.reviewText: List the supported signals before the diagnostic sequence.

children.title: Mitigate and escalate
children.scope: Expose the missing owner for the final escalation decision.
children.reviewText: Retain the supported mitigation steps and link the unresolved owner question.

children.title: Verification
children.scope: Group acceptance conditions and retained Evidence without claiming a current Test run.

children.title: Acceptance conditions
children.scope: Connect each required behavior to an observable acceptance condition.
children.reviewText: Separate required outcomes from retained Test evidence and unverified assumptions.

children.title: Document decisions
children.scope: Record the accepted order and the decision to preserve unresolved conflicts.
children.reviewText: Feed the accepted organization and named gaps into the selected document-writing method.

unresolvedQuestions.question: Who owns the final escalation decision when retry exhaustion and operator guidance disagree?
Which retained Test result proves the documented timeout threshold in the target environment?

requiredCorrections: Confirm the escalation owner before final document acceptance.
